DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENT.title: Potent
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-POTENT.description: Uses your Ability Potency for some of its stats. Values higher than 1 indicate the step size for the stat change.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-RITUAL.title: Ritual
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-RITUAL.description: Ritual spells do not consume a Spellslot when your energy is above 50%.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCROLLED.title: Scrolled
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-SCROLLED.description: Scrolled spells gain Exhaust and are free to play.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FINESSE.title: Finesse
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-FINESSE.description: Finesse weapons use Dexterity to add to their damage, whichever is highest.
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TWOHANDED.title: Two-Handed
DUNGEONSANDSPIRES-TWOHANDED.description: Two-handed weapons deal 20% more damage on subsequent attacks with the same weapon.
